verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an API to create custom controls that sit alongside library controls, and to attach documents to controls as evidence. Custom Tests turn data pushed from homegrown systems into pass/fail evidence, and the GRC page cross-maps controls across pre-built frameworks 'or ones you've customized.' missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating a wholly new custom framework (rather than customizing a pre-built one), detail on defining per-control evidence requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones

citations.quote: Deactivates a custom or Vanta control.
